component.name: Browser-17
component.summary: A web browser with its own sound chain

description.p: Browser-17 is the browser of Player-17 on its own. Everything a site plays goes through its own effects: Prism EQ, saturator, OTT and limiter, plus your VST3 plugins.
Browser-17 — браузер из Player-17 как отдельное приложение. Весь звук сайтов идёт через его эффекты: Prism EQ, сатуратор, OTT и лимитер, а также ваши плагины VST3.

ul.li: Tabs, pinned tabs, a start page with your sites
Вкладки, закреплённые вкладки, стартовая страница с вашими сайтами
Plugins 17 and VST3 effects on the sound of every site
Plugins 17 и эффекты VST3 на звуке любого сайта
Your own colors and a see-through background

description.p: No more "python3" in System Monitor: the sound host and the browser's small helper jobs are named Browser-17.
Browser-17 and its sound host show up in System Monitor by name, with the Browser-17 icon.
Security: sites ask before using the camera, microphone or location; extensions install only from the Chrome Web Store page; downloaded programs are never started from the browser.
